# [Description] + 嘅 + Noun · *[Description] + ge3 + Noun*

**Meaning:** the … that / who … (relative clauses) · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Possession and description

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Frelative-ge3).

To describe a noun with a whole phrase, put the phrase first, then 嘅, then the noun: 我尋日買嘅衫 ('the top I bought yesterday'). English puts the description after the noun; Cantonese puts it before.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我尋日買嘅衫好平。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 cam4 jat6 maai5 ge3 saam1 hou2 peng4. |
| Yale | ngóh chàhm yaht máaih ge sāam hóu pèhng. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄘㄜㆬ⁴ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄇㄚㄧ⁵ ㄍㄝ³ ㄙㄚㆬ¹ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄆㄝㄥ⁴. |
| English | The top I bought yesterday was cheap. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢係教我廣東話嘅老師。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 hai6 gaau3 ngo5 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 lou5 si1. |
| Yale | kéuih haih gaau ngóh gwóng dūng wá ge lóuh sī. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄍㄚㄨ³ ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄍㄨㄛㄥ² ㄉㄨㄥ¹ ㄨㄚ² ㄍㄝ³ ㄌㄛㄨ⁵ ㄙㄧ¹. |
| English | She's the teacher who teaches me Cantonese. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **有冇唔辣嘅嘢食呀？** |
| Jyutping | jau5 mou5 m4 laat6 ge3 je5 sik6 aa3? |
| Yale | yáuh móuh m̀h laaht ge yéh sihk a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄧㄜㄨ⁵ ㄇㄛㄨ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄌㄚㆵ⁶ ㄍㄝ³ ㄧㄝ⁵ ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Is there anything to eat that isn't spicy? |
